record.dic_text:
05541 calah {saw-law'}

字根型; TWOT - 1502,1503; 動詞

欽定本 - valued 2, trodden down 1, trodden under foot 1; 4

1) 使...顯露, 丟到一邊去
   1a) (Qal) 使某樣事情顯露出來
   1b) (Piel) 嘲笑, 輕蔑 (#哀1:15|)
2) 稱重, 平衡
   2a) (Pual) 被稱重量 (#伯28:19|)

05541 calah {saw-law'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1502,1503; v

AV - valued 2, trodden down 1, trodden under foot 1; 4

1) to make light of, toss aside
   1a) (Qal) to make light of
   1b) (Piel) to flout, reject
2) to weigh, balance
   2a) (Pual) to be weighed
